2026-03-23: Update, The power from the PMU to the steering sensor is wired wrong.

The APP only reaches 30%. Check wiring.
2026-03-xx: Resolved, Channel A and Channel B were swapped.

Almost none of the outputs seem to turn on. Pumps not running.

Vehicle gets CAN errors and the battery system doesn't wake.
2026-02-16: Resolved, The rear harness extension was pinned with the wrong gender connector but still plugged in. Brandon re-pinned one side to the correct connector.

Vehicle doesn't PreCharge and get's negative contactor cross-check faults.
2026-02-17: Resolved, The HVJB and CCS LV Connectors were swapped.

12V was browing out. May have just been a super low 12V battery.
2026-03-23: Resolved, Verified DCDC and hasn't happened since.

At normal ignition standby you get a DCDCVoltXChk fault.
2026-03-23: Resolved, Fault no longer showing up.

2026-03-xx: When trying to charge you get a ChgPortContFlt.
2026-04-15: Possibly fixed in new frimware expected by tomorrow.

2026-03-xx: Gear changes take pretty long.

Ambient air temp sensor not reading correctly.
2026-02-25: Resolved, Brandon found a pin with a bad crimp at the temp sensor.

2026-03-xx: Vehicle makes a shooshooshoo sound while driving. Doesn't seem to be related to brakes.
2026-04-15: Might need a parking brake tune again, waiting on answer from Ampere about settings not allowed by VCU.

2026-04-01: Need to commission the heat system and remove the temp PMU logic.
2026-04-15: Have new PMU program with logic ready, will need a few hours to install then verify.
2026-04-20: The CAN based heater need's to be enabled in the VCU. Need to schedule a meeting to unlock this option which is currently behind a paywall structure.
2026-04-21: Corrected VCU option to enable the heater. Need to make full climate controls schematic to answer questions needed to move on.

2026-03-23: AC system needs commissioning.
2026-03-31: AC works but condensate leaks onto the passenger's feet.
2026-04-15: Resolved, Billy fixed the hose which had fallen off.

2026-04-01: Reverse lights don't seem to be working, it's likely wiring.
2026-04-02: Resolved, Billy fixed wiring.
2026-04-15: Driver side light burned out.

2026-04-01: Getting a negative contactor welded fault in the VCU.
2026-04-02: Resolved, negative contactor was welded and Billy replaced it.
Fix the gear ratio
